why: A Dec 2024 arXiv paper (2412.02337) claims an equivalence between normality of an algebraic irrational and vanishing of a family of Riemann zeta averages; this reformulates the exact conjecture but does not settle it, and it's unclear whether the deep dive would count a proved equivalence as moving the problem or as adjacent reformulation work. All other sources confirm the conjecture remains fully open with no algebraic irrational proven normal in any base.
